intro.title: Leadership
paragraphs: Your dream is to become a successful entrepreneur and create a business that brings people together.
You have just been hired by a large multinational company where people from different cultures, backgrounds, and professions work together.
Today you enter the waiting area outside the HR office. The HR Manager is about to test your understanding of what leadership really means.

dialogues.greet:
Leadership is not about authority.
It's about responsibility, decision-making, and how you treat others.
dialogues.enterOffice: Before you move forward in your journey, you must prove that you understand what leadership really means.
dialogues.enterOffice2: Enter the HR office. Your leadership challenge begins now.
dialogues.whiteboardFound: Leadership begins with understanding core values.
dialogues.puzzle1Intro: Match the leadership action to the correct value.
dialogues.puzzle1Done:
Good leaders don't avoid responsibility.
They step forward when things are difficult.
dialogues.puzzle1Done2: Now let's see how you act in real situations.
dialogues.puzzle2Intro: Read the scenario carefully and choose the best response.
dialogues.puzzle2Done: That's right. A true leader communicates, supports, and adjusts. Now find the Leadership Reflection Card hidden in this office.
dialogues.findCard: Hints: check the desk, the drawer, and the wall frame. The card is hidden somewhere in the office.
dialogues.cardFound: Excellent. This card captures the essence of leadership. Now prove you can complete the leadership principle.
dialogues.puzzle3Intro: Fill in the blanks to complete the leadership principle.
dialogues.puzzle3Done: Well done. Now let's see if you can separate leadership facts from myths.
dialogues.puzzle4Intro: Answer these True or False questions about leadership.
dialogues.finalWords2: You demonstrated awareness, responsibility, and ethical leadership.
dialogues.finalWords3: Remember: leadership is shown through actions, not titles.
dialogues.finalWords4: You have successfully completed the Leadership Skill.
dialogues.default: Keep looking around the office for clues.

dialogues.busy: I'm just waiting for my turn. Good luck in there!

matching.title: Match the leadership action to the correct value

items.2: Making a difficult decision under pressure
items.3: Taking responsibility for a team's mistake

feedback.wrong: A leader's actions always reflect their values.
feedback.allCorrect: Well done! You matched all leadership actions to their correct values.

matching.answerOverlay:
The correct matches are:
1. Listening to team concerns → Empathy
2. Making a difficult decision under pressure → Decision-making
3. Taking responsibility for a team's mistake → Accountability
4. Clearly explaining goals and expectations → Communication

singleChoice.title: Leadership in practice
singleChoice.instructions: Choose the best response to this scenario.
singleChoice.question: Your team is behind schedule. One member is struggling, and the deadline is approaching.

options.a: Ignore the issue and wait for results
options.b: Blame the team member in front of others
options.c: Talk privately with the team member and adjust the plan

singleChoice.hint: Leadership requires fairness, communication, and support.

feedback.wrong: Leadership requires fairness, communication, and support.
feedback.correct: Correct! Talk privately with the team member and adjust the plan.

singleChoice.answerOverlay: The correct answer is: Talk privately with the team member and adjust the plan.

fillGap.title: Completing the leadership principle
fillGap.instructions: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

feedback.wrong: Leadership is not about fear or power.
feedback.correct: Well done! You completed the leadership principle correctly.

fillGap.answerOverlay:
The correct answers are:
A true leader takes responsibility, communicates with respect, and guides the team with clarity.

trueFalse.title: Leadership myths
trueFalse.instructions: Determine if each statement is True or False.

questions.text: Leaders must always have all the answers.
questions.hint: Effective leaders know when to seek input from others.

questions.text: Leadership includes listening and learning from others.
questions.hint: Listening and learning are key leadership traits.

questions.text: Good leadership builds trust within a team.
questions.hint: Trust is a fundamental outcome of good leadership.

feedback.wrong: That's not quite right. Think about it again.
feedback.correct: Excellent! You can distinguish leadership facts from myths.

trueFalse.answerOverlay:
The correct answers are:
1. FALSE – Leaders don't need all the answers; they listen and learn.
2. TRUE – Listening and learning from others is essential.
3. TRUE – Good leadership builds trust within a team.

Values understood. Decisions evaluated. Ethical behavior demonstrated.
